question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "high_enrollment_courses" AS WITH tip AS (
  SELECT term_code, subject_id, subject_title, num_enrolled_students
  FROM beaver."TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED"
), lib AS (
  SELECT term_code, subject_id, subject_title, num_enrolled_students
  FROM beaver."LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED"
), base AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(t.term_code, l.term_code) AS term_code,
         COALESCE(t.subject_id, l.subject_id) AS subject_id,
         COALESCE(t.subject_title, l.subject_title) AS subject_title,
         COALESCE(t.num_enrolled_students, l.num_enrolled_students) AS num_enrolled_students
  FROM tip t
  FULL OUTER JOIN lib l
    ON t.term_code = l.term_code AND t.subject_id = l.subject_id
), fmt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT term_code, subject_id, NULLIF(cluster_list, '') AS format_desc
  FROM beaver."SUBJECT_ENROLLABLE"
)
SELECT b.term_code,
       b.subject_id,
       b.subject_title,
       b.num_enrolled_students,
       f.format_desc
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN fmt f
  ON b.term_code = f.term_code AND b.subject_id = f.subject_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "meeting_locations" AS SELECT NULL AS term_code,
       NULL AS subject_id,
       room AS room,
       floor AS floor,
       fclt_building_key
FROM beaver."FCLT_ROOMS"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "building_addresses" AS SELECT fba.fclt_building_key,
       b.building_key,
       COALESCE(b.building_street_address,
                CONCAT_WS(' ', fba.street_number, fba.pre_directional, fba.street_name, fba.street_suffix, fba.post_directional)) AS building_street_address,
       fba.city AS city,
       fba.state AS state,
       CAST(fba.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
       b.building_number,
       b.building_name
FROM beaver."FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS" fba
LEFT JOIN beaver."BUILDINGS" b
  ON b.building_number = fba.building_number

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "meeting_locations" AS SELECT CAST(term_code AS VARCHAR) AS term_code,
       CAST(subject_id AS VARCHAR) AS subject_id,
       room AS room,
       floor AS floor,
       fclt_building_key AS fclt_building_key
FROM (
  SELECT NULL AS term_code,
         NULL AS subject_id,
         room,
         floor,
         fclt_building_key
  FROM beaver."FCLT_ROOMS"
) t

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "building_addresses" AS SELECT 
  fba.fclt_building_key AS fclt_building_key,
  b.building_key AS building_key,
  COALESCE(b.building_street_address,
           CONCAT_WS(' ', fba.street_number, fba.pre_directional, fba.street_name, fba.street_suffix, fba.post_directional)) AS building_street_address,
  fba.city AS city,
  fba.state AS state,
  CAST(fba.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
  b.building_number AS building_number,
  b.building_name AS building_name
FROM beaver."FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS" fba
LEFT JOIN beaver."BUILDINGS" b
  ON b.building_number = fba.building_number

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "high_enrollment_courses" AS SELECT term_code AS term_code,
       subject_id AS subject_id,
       subject_title AS subject_title,
       num_enrolled_students AS num_enrolled_students,
       format_desc AS format_desc
FROM high_enrollment_courses
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "high_enrollment_courses" AS SELECT ['term_code','subject_id','subject_title','num_enrolled_students','format_desc'] AS columns
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "meeting_locations" AS SELECT ['term_code','subject_id','room','floor','fclt_building_key'] AS columns
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "building_addresses" AS SELECT ['fclt_building_key','building_key','building_street_address','city','state','postal_code','building_number','building_name'] AS columns

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  h.term_code,
  h.subject_title,
  m.room,
  m.floor,
  b.building_number AS building_key,
  b.building_street_address AS building_street_address,
  b.city,
  b.state,
  CAST(b.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
  h.format_desc AS formats,
  h.num_enrolled_students
FROM high_enrollment_courses h
LEFT JOIN meeting_locations m
  ON h.term_code = m.term_code AND h.subject_id = m.subject_id
LEFT JOIN building_addresses b
  ON COALESCE(m.fclt_building_key, b.fclt_building_key) = b.fclt_building_key
WHERE h.num_enrolled_students > 300
ORDER BY h.num_enrolled_students DESC, h.term_code, h.subject_title
LIMIT 50

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    term_code,
    subject_id,
    subject_title,
    num_enrolled_students,
    format_desc
  FROM high_enrollment_courses
  WHERE num_enrolled_students > 300
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  b.term_code,
  b.subject_title,
  m.room,
  m.floor,
  COALESCE(ba.building_key, ba.building_number) AS building_key,
  COALESCE(buildings.building_street_address,
           CONCAT_WS(' ', ba.street_number, ba.pre_directional, ba.street_name, ba.street_suffix, ba.post_directional)) AS building_street_address,
  COALESCE(ba.city, buildings.building_mailing_address) AS city,
  ba.state,
  CAST(ba.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
  b.format_desc AS formats,
  b.num_enrolled_students
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN meeting_locations m
  ON b.term_code = m.term_code AND b.subject_id = m.subject_id
LEFT JOIN building_addresses ba
  ON m.fclt_building_key = ba.fclt_building_key
LEFT JOIN buildings
  ON buildings.building_number = ba.building_number
ORDER BY b.num_enrolled_students DESC, b.term_code, b.subject_title
LIMIT 50

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT term_code, subject_id, subject_title, num_enrolled_students, format_desc
  FROM high_enrollment_courses
  WHERE num_enrolled_students > 300
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  b.term_code,
  b.subject_title,
  m.room,
  m.floor,
  COALESCE(ba.building_key, ba.building_number) AS building_key,
  ba.building_street_address,
  ba.city,
  ba.state,
  CAST(ba.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
  b.format_desc AS formats,
  b.num_enrolled_students
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN meeting_locations m
  ON b.term_code = m.term_code AND b.subject_id = m.subject_id
LEFT JOIN building_addresses ba
  ON m.fclt_building_key = ba.fclt_building_key
ORDER BY b.num_enrolled_students DESC, b.term_code, b.subject_title
LIMIT 50

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  h.term_code,
  h.subject_title,
  m.room,
  m.floor,
  COALESCE(ba.building_key, ba.building_number) AS building_key,
  ba.building_street_address,
  ba.city,
  ba.state,
  CAST(ba.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
  h.format_desc AS formats,
  h.num_enrolled_students
FROM high_enrollment_courses AS h
LEFT JOIN meeting_locations AS m
  ON h.term_code = m.term_code AND h.subject_id = m.subject_id
LEFT JOIN building_addresses AS ba
  ON m.fclt_building_key = ba.fclt_building_key
WHERE h.num_enrolled_students > 300
ORDER BY h.num_enrolled_students DESC, h.term_code, h.subject_title
LIMIT 50

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  high_enrollment_courses.term_code,
  high_enrollment_courses.subject_title,
  meeting_locations.room,
  meeting_locations.floor,
  COALESCE(building_addresses.building_key, building_addresses.building_number) AS building_key,
  building_addresses.building_street_address,
  building_addresses.city,
  building_addresses.state,
  CAST(building_addresses.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
  high_enrollment_courses.format_desc AS formats,
  high_enrollment_courses.num_enrolled_students
FROM high_enrollment_courses
LEFT JOIN meeting_locations
  ON high_enrollment_courses.term_code = meeting_locations.term_code
 AND high_enrollment_courses.subject_id = meeting_locations.subject_id
LEFT JOIN building_addresses
  ON meeting_locations.fclt_building_key = building_addresses.fclt_building_key
WHERE high_enrollment_courses.num_enrolled_students > 300
ORDER BY high_enrollment_courses.num_enrolled_students DESC,
         high_enrollment_courses.term_code,
         high_enrollment_courses.subject_title
LIMIT 50
